architectural_decisions.rationale: This architecture follows the 3-layer model: Presentation, Domain, and Data.
Flux is an architecture for handling and flowing data in a web application, designed to replace the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern.
Flux proposes an architecture in which the data flow is unidirectional, thus obtaining easier debugging and scalability.

React is a library that is based on cascading components, which perform the same function as views in an MVC pattern: creating the graphical interface and keeping the rendered components updated with the data.
Due to the previous experience we already had with React, it seemed like a good idea to develop the project with this framework.
NestJS is a progressive NodeJS framework for creating efficient, reliable, and scalable backend applications.
The observer pattern is a design pattern to observe the state of an object in a program, allowing an object to maintain a list of objects that observe its state.
In this project, the decorator pattern has been used to facilitate testing tasks, as components are wrapped with it to extend their functionalities.
The concept of Lazy Loading consists of loading objects/components only when they are necessary, thus optimizing efficiency.
AWS SNS was chosen for the cost compared to Expo Push API, and because it is more scalable and can be used by other services.
